rv.q: The Mystery of Edwin Drood is a challenging, unusual, and complex piece to pull off, and it is no mystery why J2 Spotlight succeeds so well with this piece: dedication, talent, and spunk.
The result is a reminder that this delightful show with a practically flawless score should be revived more often.

cn.t: J2 Musical Theater Company delivers a panache-filled production of Holmes' Tony-winning whodunit, skillfully adapting Dickens' unfinished novel into jolly good musical entertainment.
